inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the playground I observed 5 exposed screws on wooden boards as well as an active playground.     This was corrected when the director placed treatment on the ant pile and the screws were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: CCR observed a caregiver park the van used for transportation without completing a walk-thorugh and visual check of the vehicle as well as not disarmining the alarm from the rear of the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: During the inspection I observed a caregiver not wash their hands in between cleaning two infants noses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: During the walkthrough of the building I observed a mop bucket with water in the hallway accessible to children in care.       This was corrected when a caregiver moved the bucket out of reach of the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection I observed a school age child walk out of the classroom into the halllway as well as a 4 year old go to the restroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection 1 caregiver was caring for 13 children with a specified age group of 2 years old.. Ratio is 1-11. The caregiver was over ratio by 2.     This was corrected when the second caregiver went back into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During review of naptime a room was observed to not have adequate lighting during naptime. This was corrected when the caregiver opened the classroom door to allow more lighting.

Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: During the inspection I observed a box of prescription medication sitting on a rolling cart accessible to children in care. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the medication from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: During review of infants room the cribs were found to be close enough for infants to reach into another crib.       This was corrected when the director rearranged the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §746.2403(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: During the walkthrough of the infant room the cribs were found to not have labels as required.     This was corrected when the director printed and placed lables on the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: During review of infants 3 infants not yet eating table food did not have current feeding instructions as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection I observed a caregiver without cleared eligible results caring for 6 children between 20 months and 2 years old.     Correction: Director sent caregiver home. Will not return until results have been received.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: During the walkthrough of the playground, I observed a seesaw without surfacing.     This was corrected when the operation removed the play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough of the playground, I observed 3 broken fence boards with sharp edges.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: During the inspection the operation was found to not have provided notification to parents that they no longer had liability insurance by the 3/1/2025 anniversary date.     This was corrected when the director completed and posted form 2962.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Notification to Licensing Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.205(b))
